subject.title: fix(update): fail closed on managed plugin pin conflicts

question: Should this PR land with the current selected-install-root plus legacy-project-root conflict scope, or should update command code first thread an explicit user-vs-release intent so all generation roots can be scanned without blocking rollback?
rationale: The code can implement either shape, but distinguishing a user-maintained pin from OpenClaw-owned generation rollback state is an update UX and ownership policy decision rather than a mechanically safe review repair.

options.title: Accept Current Two-Root Scope
options.body: Land the near-term fail-closed guard if maintainers agree the selected install root and legacy project root are the user-override surfaces for this bug, while generation roots remain OpenClaw-owned rollback state.

options.title: Thread Update Intent First
options.body: Require a larger cross-layer change before merge so bulk update, explicit version rollback, and user keep-pin intent are distinguishable in the install guard.

options.title: Pause For Interactive UX
options.body: Hold the PR until the interactive chooser or explicit keep-pin/release-managed flag is designed and tested.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Two-Root Scope
recommendation.body: Land the near-term fail-closed guard if maintainers agree the selected install root and legacy project root are the user-override surfaces for this bug, while generation roots remain OpenClaw-owned rollback state.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete wrote the maintainer policy note that sets the fail-closed direction and is assigned on the PR.
